description: Deletes one key of a site's store, for good. Only when the person asked. Refused when the key has no value. Works even while the month's store operations are spent, so a full store can be cleaned up.

key.description: The key, as store_list shows it. Up to 512 bytes; any characters, `:` and `/` included.

site.description: Subdomain or site id, from list_sites.

name: store_delete
title: Delete a store key
